data.name: Mubayyin
data.gender_notes: Mubayyin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘b-y-n’, meaning to clarify or explain. In Islamic context, Mubayyin is a name given to someone who makes things clear, or a guide who illuminates the path for others. The name Mubayyin carries the meaning “Maker of things clear” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mubayyin usually hope their child will grow to embody maker of things clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are given the gift of clear communication and truth, helping to bring enlightenment and understanding to others
data.etymology: Mubayyin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Maker of things clear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mubayyin total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: مُبَيِّن
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُبَيِّن هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني الواضح الذي يظهر ويفسر الأمور بوضوح، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة يونس: وَهُوَ الْمُبَيِّنُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ

in_urdu.name: مُبَیِّن
in_urdu.meaning: وضاحت کرنے والا، ظاہر کرنے والا، بیان کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مُبَیِّن ایک عظیم اسماء اللہ میں سے ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے وہ جو چیزیں واضح کرتا ہے، ظاہر کرتا ہے اور ان کی تشریح کرتا ہے، اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں یونس کے سورة میں کیا گیا ہے: وَهُوَ الْمُبَيِّنُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، اور یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: मुबय्यिन
in_hindi.meaning: स्पष्ट करने वाला, प्रकट करने वाला, व्याख्या करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुबय्यिन अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है जो चीजों को स्पष्ट करता है, प्रकट करता है और उनकी व्याख्या करता है, इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में सूरा यूनस में किया गया है: وَهُوَ الْمُبَيِّنُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ, और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्व रखता है

in_pashto.name: مُبَيّن
in_pashto.meaning: روښانه کوونکی، ښکاره کوونکی، بیان کوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: مُبَيّن د الله ښکلي نومونو څخه يو دی، چې معنی يې دى هغه څوک چې امور واضح کوي، ښکاره کوي او بيان کوي، د يونس په سورت کې يې ذکر شوی دی: وَهُوَ الْمُبَيِّنُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، او دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانو په دود کې ډیر اهمیت لري

in_english.name: Mubayyin
in_english.long_meaning: Mubayyin is one of the beautiful names of Allah, meaning the one who clarifies, reveals, and expounds. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Yunus: وَهُوَ الْمُبَيِّنُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ. The name Mubayyin has its root in the Arabic language, derived from the root 'B-Y-N', which means 'to clarify' or 'to make clear'. This name signifies the attribute of Allah as the one who makes things clear and manifest. In Islamic tradition, Mubayyin is considered a name that reflects the divine attribute of guidance and clarification. It is a name that embodies the qualities of illumination, understanding, and insight. Across Muslim cultures, Mubayyin is used as a given name for boys, symbolizing the hope that the child will grow up to be a source of guidance and clarity for others

data.cultural_impact: The name Mubayyin carries a deep significance in Islamic culture. It is a reminder of the importance of clear communication, guidance, and leadership. This name is revered in various Islamic domains and communities, particularly in Sufism and Shia traditions, where spiritual growth and knowledge is highly valued.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Mubayyin is rooted in the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who stated, "I leave two things among you: the Sunnah and the Prophetic Tradition (Hadith)." Mubayyin, as someone who clarifies and explains, represents an embodiment of this message. A Mubayyin is not just a teacher, but a source of guidance, providing light and clarity to those seeking knowledge and spiritual growth. This name serves as a constant reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge, understanding, and guidance in our daily lives.
